packs.title: Fuse Worms
packs.description: Worms that meet, fuse and split again, riding a slow wave that remembers where they've been: Gray-Scott with a history chemical and a travelling wave feeding back into it.

packs.title: Chasms and Swirls
packs.description: Spots carve canyons into the wave history and swirl along their walls: deep trails, fractured floors and slow spirals.

packs.title: Puffy Gliders
packs.description: Soft gliders that puff, bud and leave a temporal web of their paths behind them.

packs.title: Active Mesh
packs.description: A living net: cells that hold their places in a mesh, pulse and rearrange when the wave passes through. Some get psychedelic.

packs.title: Flowy Dots
packs.description: Sparse dots drifting through a cloud tank, each with a long, smooth wave wake trailing behind.

packs.title: Deep Currents
packs.description: Gray-Scott whose history runs on a DC wave: fibrous fills, powered-up a and b, and patterns that keep reorganising long after they've settled.

packs.title: Wigglers
packs.description: Restless worms that wiggle and never quite settle, on wave settings tuned for nervous energy.

packs.title: Dot Fights
packs.description: Oscillating worms, single solitons and super-long trails competing for space.

packs.title: Evolving Mask
packs.description: Gray-Scott with a slowly evolving mask chemical that redraws the map of where spots may live: separations, branching fronts and froth.

packs.title: Wave-Coupled Gray-Scott
packs.description: The first experiments coupling Gray-Scott to a wave and a history chemical: bouncy space-fillers, echoes and wakes.

packs.title: History Wave
packs.description: Gray-Scott spots writing their history into a wave they then ride - lifey, unstable, sometimes dollar-shaped.

packs.title: Sharpened Gray-Scott
packs.description: Gray-Scott with a sharpening tweak: crisp cell trails, gelatinous blobs, ropes and Voronoi-ish cells.

packs.title: Meta Gray-Scott
packs.description: Gray-Scott running on top of another Gray-Scott - worms, solitons and fiestas from two coupled layers.

packs.title: U-Skate World
packs.description: Robert Munafo's U-Skate world of Gray-Scott: skaters, spin gliders, block worlds and travelling smiles.

packs.title: Gray-Scott Demos
packs.description: Gray-Scott in its many moods: photo-solitons, worms, popping dots and organising mish-mashes.

packs.title: Orbits: Boundary Pulses
packs.description: Dan's Orbit rule with pulses sent in from the edges: life waves and spaceships.

packs.title: Orbits: Julia
packs.description: Orbit rule tests - Julia-set dynamics in a reaction-diffusion, phases, slow spins and odd squiggles.

packs.title: Orbits: Nova
packs.description: The Nova variant of the Orbit rule: communities, beans, sausages, fractal tiles and chaos holes.

packs.title: Orbits: Chaos Spirals
packs.description: Orbit patterns evolved by hand towards chaos spirals, travelling crystals and mungey waves.

packs.title: Orbits
packs.description: Dan's own Orbit rule (pow, atan2 and direct assignments): soft spots, epochs and explodey buddhas.

packs.title: Cell Spirals
packs.description: Ginzburg-Landau ramped across the grid so spirals become cells: honeycombs, mazes, web fences, turing columns and continuous mitosis.

packs.title: Complex Ginzburg-Landau
packs.description: The complex Ginzburg-Landau equation: spirals and anti-spirals, chaos mush, soft soliton webs.

packs.title: Ginzburg-Landau Waves
packs.description: Ginzburg-Landau magnitude coupled to a wave and a history: long wakes, embryos and negotiations.

packs.title: Ginzburg-Landau Magnitude
packs.description: Ginzburg-Landau with its magnitude remapped: slipping spirals, cell ordering, disco and smoke.

packs.title: Boiling Heat
packs.description: A heat equation with history and a wave, boiling: ripple gliders, windscreen rain, ripple meshes and travellers.

packs.title: Waves and Heat
packs.description: The wave and heat equations, ripples and kernels: the plainest physics, as patterns of their own.

packs.title: Kuramoto-Sivashinsky
packs.description: Flame fronts: the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation's flame puffs, hot clusters, pockets and hexagons.

packs.title: Excitable Media
packs.description: FitzHugh-Nagumo: nerve-like pulses, splitting tips, spiral turbulence and pulsing mazes.

packs.title: Ready Classics
packs.description: Patterns from Ready's own collection: Yang's jumping waves, McCabe, Meinhardt's stripes, Schrodinger packets, Purwins' gliders and more.

packs.title: Life and Friends
packs.description: Cellular automata and their smooth cousins from Ready's collection: Conway's Life, Larger than Life, SmoothLife gliders, salt, erosion, smoke and the community's own experiments.
